liminal_instructions.ship_drive: We've found Instructions that bend space-time, compressing and expanding space around a Linkage. Unfortunately, hyperspace is too unstable for this to speed up travel, but I'm sure you can imagine the combat applications.
liminal_instructions.bad_missile: We can create a field that absorbs explosive energy. It hampers our missiles, but leaves room in the template.
liminal_instructions.bad_energy: By diffusing our energy weapons' output across space-time, we make them slower and costlier to fire, but leave room in the template.
liminal_instructions.bad_ballistic: A field interferes with our ballistic weapons, but we can harness the energy it takes from them for other Instructions.
liminal_instructions.bad_flux: We redirect some of the ship's flux dissipation to power additional Instructions.
liminal_instructions.heavy_armor: By partially phasing the hull's armor into an adjacent dimension, we can increase its effective thickness. We use other dimensions a lot for these Instructions, though we don't really understand what's going on.
liminal_instructions.insulated_engines: We can redirect engine emissions into pocket dimensions. Emissions in other dimensions are harder to detect, for obvious reasons.
liminal_instructions.high_maintenance: To maintain the ship's connection to the Liminality, we need constant reality anchoring. A more durable anchor costs more to maintain, but leaves room in the template.
liminal_instructions.flux_shunt: We've discovered a way to shunt hard flux into nothingness. It is much less efficient than normal flux dissipation, but it can work in a pinch!
liminal_instructions.extended_shield: By folding space around the shield emitters, we can extend our shield's coverage. Become invincible! At least until you overload.
liminal_instructions.weapon_range: By compressing the space between our weapons and their targets, we can effectively increase their range. There's no way bending space like this could go wrong!
liminal_instructions.weapon_damage: Dimensional overlap adds mass and energy to every shot our weapons fire. Large improvements are beyond us, but every little bit helps.
liminal_instructions.salvage_gantry: By slightly altering probability fields around salvage operations, we can increase their yield. Try it in a casino!
liminal_instructions.ground_attack: Localized time dilation speeds up our marines on the ground. The larger the ship, the more marines its field can cover.
liminal_instructions.bad_turrets: The turrets run out of sync with their targeting systems. They turn slowly, but it leaves room in the template.
liminal_instructions.maneuverability: The Liminality lowers the ship's inertia, so it accelerates, brakes, and turns faster.
liminal_instructions.fighter_defense: A field around the ship's fighters spreads the damage they take across parallel realities.
liminal_instructions.rugged_construction: The Liminality strengthens the conceptual forces binding the ship's materials together, reducing the negative effects of d-mods. That's what this summary says, anyway.
liminal_instructions.fighter_recovery: By manipulating causality around the fighter bays, the Liminality can make it so that pilots we lost didn't actually die. Don't ask about the ethical implications.
liminal_instructions.burn_drive: Unlike existing Alcubierre Drives, our version can now operate in hyperspace! It's not as simple as in normal space, but it works.
liminal_instructions.efficiency: The Liminality reduces friction and waste throughout the ship. Parts last longer and the drive burns less fuel.
liminal_instructions.cargo_expansion: The Liminality creates pockets of expanded space within the cargo holds and fuel tanks.
liminal_instructions.weapon_op_reduction: The Liminality takes over part of the work of running each weapon and fighter wing, so they need fewer ordnance points.
liminal_instructions.missile_reload: The Liminality creates brief causal loops in the missile tubes, letting us unfire missiles and fire them again.
liminal_instructions.fighter_bay: We build whole hangar bays in pocket dimensions! Some pilots may go insane, but that's a sacrifice we're willing to make.
liminal_instructions.time_flow: The more damage the ship takes, the more the Liminality speeds up time aboard it.
liminal_instructions.regen: The Liminality reverses entropy in damaged sections of the ship. We tried causal loops first, but the repairs kept arriving before the damage.
liminal_instructions.damage_cap: When the hull takes too much damage at once, we diffuse the excess across other timelines.
liminal_instructions.glitched_actuators: Some Instructions arrive corrupted, and the weapon actuators mostly run them anyway. We could fix it, but the corrupted copy gives back two whole points of template space.
liminal_instructions.liquid_armor: The armor is kept just short of solid. It flows into damaged sections and evens itself out.
liminal_instructions.breach_targeting: The Liminality shows our targeting computers the weak points in enemy weapon mounts and engines.
liminal_instructions.fire_discipline: The Liminality tells each weapon where its target will be and steadies it as it fires.
liminal_instructions.close_air_support: The ship's Linkage reaches fighters that stay close to it and strengthens their weapons.
liminal_instructions.flash_repair: When a battle ends, the Liminality partially reverts the ship to its condition before the fight.
liminal_instructions.capacitor_blanking_plates: Empty weapon mounts are capped with plates that route their unused power to the flux vents.
liminal_instructions.override_beacon: Nav buoys and comm relays believe this ship has always owned them.
liminal_instructions.anchored_firing_solutions: A ship that holds still becomes a fixed point in reality, and its weapons fire faster.

liminal_dialog.planet_win_1: With the defenders defeated, your fleet moves in and deploys the reality anchors. Once placed, they activate and the Entity's hold begins to fail.
liminal_dialog.planet_win_2: Space begins to knit itself back together. The buildings that were larger inside than out collapse in on themselves, leaving nothing but empty foundations. The wound seals shut with a soundless flash.
liminal_dialog.planet_win_3: What remains is just another lifeless world.
liminal_dialog.planet_loss: You were unable to overcome the defenders.
liminal_dialog.boss_engage_option: Engage the Avatar of the Entity
liminal_dialog.boss_reengage_option: Re-engage the Avatar of the Entity
liminal_dialog.boss_win_1: The Avatar of the Entity comes apart, each fragment guttering out in the dark between dimensions. The connection to the Entity's universe begins to fail, and the wound it opened folds shut behind it with an echo every person in the fleet feels but no instrument records.
liminal_dialog.boss_win_2: As you cross back into normal space, the Entity's hold on the Sector is already gone. The fleets of the Servants of the Entity have vanished, and every world they held is dead. What they took is not coming back, but the invasion is over.
liminal_dialog.boss_win_3: Back at %s, Elna stands before the Liminality, which now pulses with a steadier light. The cradle where Jarn died has been rebuilt.
liminal_dialog.boss_win_4: "We've learned so much," she says quietly. "About the Liminality, about the Entity. It will try again, in some other universe if not this one. But its language... we could read scraps of it when this began. We can read whole pages now."
liminal_dialog.boss_win_5: She turns to you with a small smile. "Thank you. You funded us when no one else would. Jarn would have been proud."
liminal_dialog.boss_win_reward: All Liminal Templates can now contain 30% more OP of Instructions
liminal_dialog.boss_loss: The Avatar of the Entity defeats you.
